name: Neuroscience PhD
summary: UMMC doctoral program that trains independent researchers. Research exposure starts in the first semester, and students pick a dissertation lab after surveying several labs. Focus areas include brain trauma and spinal cord injury.
detailsNote: The program pages reached give no admission requirements, so only the graduate school's general dates, fee and application page are used. Dates carry no year, so Fall 2027 is not confirmed. Admission model, GRE, letters, English minimums and funding are not stated on the pages reached.
